summary: Code review PASS — all 4 acceptance criteria independently verified.
PHPUnit: 33 tests, 44 assertions — all green (independently run by reviewer).
AC1: composer test runs successfully, all 33 pagination tests pass with exit code 0 — confirmed.

AC2: GridPaginationTest (20 tests) covers: getTotalPages (5 tests: exact/remainder/zero/single/equal), getCurrentPage clamping (4 tests: below min/above max/within range/zero items), getPageNumbers (7 tests: small no-ellipsis/large two-ellipsis/first page/last page/zero items/single page/null counting), hasPreviousPage/hasNextPage (5 tests: first/middle/last/both), getPageURLTemplate (1 test: placeholder present, sentinel absent) — confirmed.

AC3: ArrayPaginationTest (13 tests) covers: getSlicedItems (4 tests: first/middle/last/single-item last page), getPageURL (3 tests: add when absent/replace when present/custom param), plus totalItems, itemsPerPage, currentPage clamping — confirmed.

AC4: GridPaginationTest uses anonymous PaginationInterface stub with zero global state. ArrayPaginationTest saves/restores $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] in setUp/tearDown. No test reads $_GET or $_POST without explicit setup — confirmed.
Test quality is high: proper helper methods, strict assertions, clear section organization, comprehensive edge cases.

comments.note: GridPaginationTest uses an anonymous class implementing PaginationInterface as a stub provider — excellent design choice that fully decouples pagination logic tests from ArrayPagination's constructor (which reads $_GET). Zero global state dependency.

Test naming consistently follows test_methodName_scenario convention. All assertions use assertSame() for strict type+value checks where appropriate, and assertStringContainsString/assertStringNotContainsString for URL parameter order independence.

ArrayPaginationTest setUp/tearDown correctly handles the case where REQUEST_URI may not be set initially (null check before unset in tearDown). Tests that don't call getPageURL() (totalItems, itemsPerPage, currentPage clamping) correctly skip setting REQUEST_URI.

getPageNumbers() tests provide comprehensive edge-case coverage: small page count (no ellipsis), large page count (two ellipsis), current at first/last page, zero items, single page, and explicit null sentinel counting.
test_getPageURLTemplate_containsPlaceholder verifies both the presence of {PAGE} and the absence of raw numeric sentinel — a good defensive check against sentinel leakage.
